name: Dearest Colara,
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
How to describe her beauty? Thousands of years of words and I am at a loss.

These mortals confound the mind and leave us babbling fools.

I've stared at these words too long. No more eloquent meaning can I squeeze from them. No, she must have it now, or some other suitor will surely steal her eye.
narrative.objectives: Deliver the Immaculate Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: I've never received something like this before. How lovely!
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello there, handsome. Something I can help you with?
